say:3:1620882102:1.text: You said the ritual was meant to make us stronger. Why... why did it end up summoning Hypofiends?
say:3:1620882102:1.source_cn: 您不是说，仪式是用来帮助我们获取更强的力量的吗？为什么...

say:4:1620882103:1.text: Tell me, who do you think wields the greatest power in the world?
say:4:1620882103:1.source_cn: 告诉我，这世界上最强大的力量，是由谁来掌控的呢？

say:6:1620882105:1.text: Wrong. The greatest power is held by a being far beyond our understanding.
say:6:1620882105:1.source_cn: 不，不是神。那是你我都无法理解的存在。

say:7:1620882106:1.text: But you're right to say that gods are formidable. The power you seek is nothing but a drop in the ocean compared to theirs.
say:7:1620882106:1.source_cn: 但你说得不错，神的确很强大。你所渴慕、所向往的魔力，不...

say:8:1620882107:1.text: To gain greater power, we need to seize it from the gods... or from those akin to them.
say:8:1620882107:1.source_cn: 若想要弥补己身的缺陷与瑕疵，需得从神……或是与神相似的...

say:9:1620882108:1.text: Master, I'm not sure what you mean...

say:11:1620882110:1.text: Hypogeans are as mighty as gods. Whatever a god can give, a Hypogean can too.
say:11:1620882110:1.source_cn: 那是与神相似的存在。它拥有着你无法想象的强大力量，神能...

say:12:1620882111:1.text: Many of us crave the power of the Hypogeans. Together, we formed a secret society and mastered a form of magic unlike any other.
say:12:1620882111:1.source_cn: 我们渴慕这种力量，于是秘密结社，进行研究。我们成功了—...

say:13:1620882112:1.text: You mean... all the spells you showed me...
say:13:1620882112:1.source_cn: 是您向我展示的……那种魔法……

say:14:1620882113:1.text: Yes, that's the power drawn from Hypogeans and Hypofiends.
say:14:1620882113:1.source_cn: 没错。这就是我们从恶魔与魔物身上获得的力量。

say:15:1620882114:1.text: Unlike the power of gods, which you can only receive passively, this is a power you can <style="highlight">seize at will</style>.
say:15:1620882114:1.source_cn: 不像普通的魔力，你只能被动地等待，将神抛下的一点渣滓视...

say:16:1620882115:1.text: This power can make you the greatest mage in the world. You'll become hundreds, even thousands of times stronger than those so-called Legendmakers!
say:16:1620882115:1.source_cn: 只要你想，就能凭借它成为世间最强的魔法师，甚至比那些所...

say:17:1620882116:1.text: ...Ugh... I can't believe... I missed the opportunity!
say:17:1620882116:1.source_cn: ……可恶……这样的事情……我竟然错过了！！！

say:18:1620882117:1.text: I could have gained immense power just now...
say:18:1620882117:1.source_cn: 我竟然错过了获得如此强大力量的机会，我——

say:19:1620882118:1.text: *Chuckle* Don't worry, the ritual isn't over. You still have another shot.
say:19:1620882118:1.source_cn: 呵呵……不要心急，你还有机会。仪式还没有结束。

say:20:1620882119:1.text: Summoning Hypofiends was only the first step. Now, our goal is to call forth a <style="highlight">Hypogean</style>.
say:20:1620882119:1.source_cn: 召唤出魔物只是开始。这一次，我们的目标……是召唤出一只...

say:21:1620882120:1.text: We'll <style="highlight">claim its power</style> and become masters of dark magic!
